result:
Fixed in `anthrouter/pace.py`. `tests/test_pace.py` passes (30 tests). The full suite timed out in the foreground and is still running in the background, so I haven't seen its result.

`period_workday_dates` treated the period end (Oct 1 00:00 UTC) as inclusive, so Thursday Oct 1 was counted as a September workday. That gave 23 instead of 22. It now uses the last instant before `period_end` (end minus 1 µs), and I updated the docstring to match.
